experience.title: Product Data Analyst
facts: Uses SQL and Python to analyze conversion, retention, and acquisition funnels.
Designs and analyzes A/B tests for checkout and onboarding changes.
Built and maintained Tableau dashboards for weekly conversion, retention, and experiment reporting.
Partners with product managers and engineers to define metrics and prioritize improvements.
